title: Full wall of PAX wardrobes with painted doors
summary: IKEA PAX frames with boxes on top to the ceiling, and painted panelled doors across the front.
intro: A full wall of wardrobes for a bedroom. IKEA PAX frames along the wall, boxes on top to take them up to the ceiling, and painted panelled doors across the front, so it reads as one built-in piece rather than flat-pack.
